reviews.title: DPF (Diesel Particulate Filter) Clogging
reviews.howToFix: Allow DPF regeneration by driving at highway speeds (65+ MPH) for 15-20 minutes regularly. For forced regen via VCDS: go to adaptation, enter security code 12233, change channel 18 from 0 to 1 while maintaining highway speed. Monitor soot levels via VCDS (Particle Filter Carbon Mass). If severely clogged, professional DPF cleaning with Liqui Moly 20110 DPF Cleaning Fluid (used with 20112 DPF Cleaning Flush and 7945/7946 spray tools) can help. Note: cleaning removes soot only, not ash - ash accumulation requires DPF replacement. OEM replacement DPF often back-ordered for weeks.

reviews.howToFix: Regular oil changes with VW 507.00 spec diesel oil are critical - the turbo depends on clean oil for bearing lubrication.
